what: NUCLEO-F429ZI OSCORE victim, standard build, 600 000 exchanges, 2026-09-12

victim.stack: uoscore-uedhoc + TinyCrypt over lwIP, out of STM32CubeF4, as shipped

geometry.note: 0x0801120c is 12 bytes into its 16-byte flash row, so the row a lookup hits is (x+12)>>4 and not x>>4. line_off is in table ENTRIES, which for a byte table is the same number as the byte offset. Read it off the ELF with flashleak.row_offset_from_image; do not assume 0. At line_off=0 this same capture scores 3/16 at 150k where the right geometry gives 16/16 and a verified key.

attack.expect_note: master key recovered and verified from the first 150 000 traces

truth.note: RFC 8613 C.1 server sender key. Public, and present in the vector because the keystream the attacker read off the wire is regenerated from it rather than stored - see host/make_vector.py. The recovery never reads it; tools/replay.py compares against it at the end.
